title: Chapter 1440 - 14: Sixty Thousand Years Later
content:
Chapter 1440 - 14: Sixty Thousand Years Later

Chapter 1440 - 14: Sixty Thousand Years Later

Although this is just speculation, the Purple Light Legendary Lord is almost certainly confirmed.

The Endless White Jade Staircase is so extraordinary, its aura has an air of transcending everything.

"What should we do now?"

A Legendary Lord asked in a low voice.

The implication was how to deal with Lin Yuan.

Currently, Lin Yuan's strength is ordinary, not even at the lord level.

But in the future, Lin Yuan is highly likely to be one of the strongest Legendary Lords in the vast Dimensional Gap, and also linked to transcendence.

"Keep a distance."

The Purple Light Legendary Lord pondered for a moment and said in a low voice.

"Keep a distance?"

The other Legendary Lords glanced at each other.

Lin Yuan's future is too terrifying, even incomprehensible to the Legendary Lords.

Facing such an existence, the Legendary Lords are in awe and dare not offend.

But to intentionally get close? They also dare not, fearing to bear some gigantic karmic burden and get stuck in it.

The stronger the power, the higher the realm, the more one can feel the terrifying connection between the vast Dimensional Gap and transcendence.

Perhaps an ordinary lord would rush to befriend Lin Yuan upon seeing such a powerful future.

But Legendary Lords see further, related to transcendence?

Throughout history, those who tried to approach or get close to transcendence almost all died.

No good ending.

Legendary Lords are willing to bear life-and-death risks for transcendence, but they don't want to die inexplicably.

"Yes, keep a distance."

The Purple Light Legendary Lord nodded, "And absolutely do not offend Him."

"Understood."

All the Legendary Lords said.

...

Diverting his eyes from the cosmic spoils stored within him, Lin Yuan glanced around.

At this moment, several Time Lords were cautiously and tentatively observing him.

"You may leave now."

Lin Yuan was not the Blood Sea Lord and was not interested in acts of plunder.

In fact, with His current strength, he couldn't plunder, and as for summoning his future self?

The future self is a trump card, frequently summoning the future self will have profound impacts on the timeline, just as current spatial-time lords have the power to change the past but dare not change it at will.

Even strong Legendary Lords might cause enormous risks by interfering with the past.

For example, the Blood Sea Lord, who in the future steps into the legendary level, interferes with the current space-time, resulting in attracting Lin Yuan's future self.

This is an enormous risk.

An unpredictable enormous risk.

Lin Yuan is also worried that frequently summoning his future self might cause similar troubles.

And summoning the future self requires the consent of the future self.

If my past self frequently summoned him to resolve troubles in the past, Lin Yuan would also be annoyed.

"We may leave?"

The Time Lords slightly breathed a sigh of relief.

Compared to the Blood Sea Lord forcibly coercing them into handing over large amounts of Sand of Time by summoning his future self.

The methods Lin Yuan exhibited required no coercion, just a simple word was enough.

No lord dared to refuse Lin Yuan's request.

"May I know your title, sir?"

A Time Lord tentatively asked.

"Galaxy."

Lin Yuan said in a calm tone.

By now, there was no need to hide his identity.

"Galaxy?"

All the lords present deeply memorized this title, then gradually left.

...

After sending the spoils out of Wanwei Space with a split avatar.

Lin Yuan's gaze turned towards the deepest part of Wanwei Space.

Wanwei Space is divided into three levels: the outer area, the deep area, and the deepest area.

The outer area is where ordinary lords explore, the deep area is for the second-level lords, while the deepest area...

Only lords who reach the Legendary Threshold can get close; to enter, one must either be a Legendary Lord or a special second-level extreme lord.

Lin Yuan has explored the deep area for thousands of years, and the harvest is enough, so he now wants to head to the deepest area and have a look.

He doesn't expect to enter the deepest area, as long as he can get close and take a look, it'll be enough.

It is said that in the deepest area, the information left by the Wanwei Lord for future Legendary Lords is related to the path of transcendence, which is also why every time Wanwei Space opens, Legendary Lords come in.

Swoosh.

Lin Yuan immediately flew towards the deepest area of Wanwei Space.

...

Years later.

Lin Yuan finally arrived outside the deepest area.

Ahead was a twisted void entrance, where several Time Lords sparsely gathered outside.

The lords appearing here are those who have touched the Legendary Threshold, most of whom are directly second-level extreme lords.

Lords who touched the Legendary Threshold come here to see, while second-level extreme lords desire to enter the deepest area.

To enter the deepest area, two prerequisites.

Either become a Legendary Lord.

Or be a special second-level extreme lord.

The "special" here has no specific requirements, as long as one can enter the entrance.

Lin Yuan looked at the twisted void entrance, and the Space-Time Rules of this entrance were extremely special, completely different from the normal Space-Time Rules of the outside world.

"Truly worthy of being the Wanwei Lord."

Lin Yuan marveled in his heart; just by watching this void entrance, he vaguely sensed the elegance of the former Wanwei Lord.

That is the absolute mastery of space-time, even to the point of creating his own Space-Time Rules based on the existing space-time.

Just as Lin Yuan was observing the void entrance.

The originally calm void entrance suddenly surged with waves, and a figure was forcibly thrown out.

"No!"

This figure was extremely unwilling, and He steadied himself, looking at the void entrance, wanting to enter again, but was forcibly blocked.
